Done! Created `scripts/help.js` that lists all scripts with their descriptions:

```
average-order.js: prints the average order value (ignoring refunds)
check-data.js: validates all orders have required fields (id, customer, numeric amount, YYYY-MM-DD date)
count-orders.js: prints how many orders are in data/orders.json
customers-json.js: prints distinct customers sorted by name as pretty JSON
daily-report.js: prints a summary report (orders, total revenue, best day)
demo-format.js: prints example formatted euro values
export-csv.js: prints all orders as CSV to stdout
largest-order.js: prints the single largest order with all fields
refunds.js: prints each refund and the total refunded amount
revenue-by-month.js: prints revenue per month (YYYY-MM format), oldest month first
search.js: node scripts/search.js <text> - finds orders by customer name (case-insensitive)
timing.js: benchmarks loadOrders() over 1000 calls
top-customers.js: prints the 3 customers with the highest total spend
```
